patterns.note: Asymmetric content alignment, often with key information or labels positioned to the far left, creating a strong visual anchor against the main content block.
Dramatic juxtaposition of extremely large, bold sans-serif display headings with elegant, thin script fonts for secondary titles and small, uppercase sans-serif for functional labels.
High-contrast palette featuring a dominant light background, dark text, and occasional full-width black sections that serve as visual breaks and provide contrast for white text.
A monumental, semi-transparent text element ('WORKS') is fixed in the background, creating a layered depth effect as foreground content scrolls over it.
Sections are separated by vast amounts of negative space, emphasizing minimalism and allowing each content block to breathe, sometimes punctuated by a full-bleed background color change.

technique_notes: The site employs a fixed background element with extremely large, semi-transparent typography that remains static while the main content scrolls over it, creating a sense of depth and visual layering.
Scroll-triggered animations, likely using GSAP, reveal content sections with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement.

A minimalist top navigation and bottom footer are initially hidden or partially off-screen, then become fixed to the viewport edges after an initial scroll, providing persistent access to navigation and branding.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold sans-serif display headings (~8-10x body) are contrasted with elegant script subheadings (~2x body) and small, uppercase sans-serif labels (~1x body).
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently used throughout the design, with no visible rounded elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, characterized by generous vertical and horizontal padding, especially around major headings and between distinct content sections, creating a sense of spaciousness.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the use of monumental, fixed background typography ('WORKS') that foreground content scrolls over, creating a strong sense of depth and a unique visual anchor for the page. This, combined with the minimalist, high-contrast aesthetic and elegant script accents, elevates it beyond a generic portfolio template.
